author: Pixeldensity
body:
Beo doesn't use gear to boost damage directly too much so you aren't missing a lot there. Usually you build gear for survivability and buff your pet for dmg. 

-Fey Gerd Legs 

-Fey Gerd Chest

If you can find good ones they're worth using and give some +stats to pet. You're going to be using that Fey Surtr's chest though, best +ward in the game. 

Don't bother with the Lugus Gauntlet if you're using Spiritgarm, pet already casts +++TMag and the +++TAtk doesn't really help you. Use that slot for something else, personally I usually just leave a Briny Pendant there when raiding to help with redlining. You could go with an arch-gadget for def and res drop immunity or use the Old Northren Crown for that. You could also use a 2nd Beo charm, don't forget, redlining increases your pet action rate as well as damage.

Keep Wisps Heal (1 not 2) spell on your list to help with redlining.

Keep Cure Bleeding as well when raiding.

Get to work on Towers and unlock Beo Auriga. Doublecast on your Spiritgarm is great, easy raids are dead before I'm done buffing and getting to redline.

Your first celestial weapon Should most likely be a Celestial Axe with +ward recovery augments. You can build it with +pet stats instead but the ward recovery is really good.

Start cranking out Ascension Levels

Find a Fey Cactus if you don't already have it. Fey Cactus and Arisen Spiritgarm will cover almost all of your offensive damage needs.

Also, Snotra. And if using Fey Cactus, Gunnr.

author: Loukhi
body:
Beo Auriga will give the dog extra turns,
Call of Brynn will help the dog keep GM active
Arisen or Fey Gerds gear is really good, try to get some while they're available.
Celestial lute with pet boost augments

Also crit+ and Tcrit+ from wyrms song and evasive strikes will make your dog crit more. 

Just as a tip though, it gets to a certain point where survivability becomes more important than extra damage. The boost for pet strength is additive, so it won't actually effect the pet that significantly. Which is why I make these recommendations, as an experienced beo;

Go after high ward gear, for a weapon the celestial axe, or bow for the added dex (but any celestial weapon will do)  with ward recovery augments will be irreplaceable and the higher you can manage to get your ward the better it will get. The Gerd gear remains recommended for this very reason, but any gear that boosts ward will work.

On an alternate level;

Beo Hydrus is also quite awesome! You'll need crit gear for it to really shine, but once you get to that point, it'll provide a much needed variety to your playstyle.

author: Romanovich0195
body:
Beo. That’s tricky one, because You can’t increase it just in a click.
As per Kingdom folks and local community I have got next advices:
- If You want go higher damage go full Celestial Lute with a Legs of Selene. These will give Follower Stats +10 per augment, which will be pretty good boost
- Ascension Levels. These should be pretty high as for a person who just started with a T10(some says 30 for the start is good to show off high damage)
- Get Celestial Class. I went with BeoA (Beowulf Auriga). Raids are just sweeping.
- As per Ragnarok event try to get Ornate Fey Surtr Cuirass; Rest could be Fey Gerd’s (boost follower), Arisen or Coiled Shield, Vritra Charm and Arch Gadget; Gilgamesh Axe would be good Ward wise; or Gradlon’s Archistaff for matk (it’s two-handed), but ward total could be a little bit lower without a shield 
- As per pet - ASG (Arisen Spiritgarm); but be careful of statuses; keep track of HP and use Wisp’s 3
- Spells : Ward of Ortanite, Golem’s Fortitude, Jinn’s Talent, Divine Bastion 2, Gait of Snotra, Call of Skadi 2 (if available; otherwise 1), Deific Channel, Wisp’s Heal 2, Transference 3

author: Wired01
body: Beo Hydras is also a fun play style. Focusing more on personal damage more than pet damage. Get a celestial lute with hybrid boost augments (I use 2 turn reduction augments on mine as well for quick ultima casts), and high crit, pair it with something like arisen stonewarg and high enough ward and you can become pretty much immortal while hitting for good damage.
